kurz: Two identical gingerbreads, one in a tin with an apple slice: after two days it is noticeably softer.
bild_im_kopf: Like a humidifier in a little room.
beobachtung: The gingerbread with the apple is soft, the other has stayed hard. The apple slice has gone wrinkly.
erklaerung: The apple gives off water into the air in the tin. The honey and sugar in the [[g-lebkuchen|gingerbread]] draw in this moisture and hold on to it.
schritte: Put one gingerbread in each tin.
Add the apple slice to one tin.
Close both and compare after two days: press and taste.
material: two identical, slightly hard gingerbreads or biscuits
two tins or jars with lids
